Once the corresponding DDS Request and Reply Topics are ready for use, the Do-
mainParticipant assigned to the Service Instance shall create:
• [SWS_CM_11106] A DDS DataReader of the DDS Request Topic to handle re-
quests using the DDS Subscriber created in [SWS_CM_90503].
• [SWS_CM_11107] A DDS DataWriter of the DDS Reply Topic to handle replies
using the DDS Publisher created in [SWS_CM_90503].
Topic objects may be reused across service instances; therefore, they shall not be
removed until the enclosing DomainParticipant is destroyed.
